subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket stop inheriting ambient proxy env by default, even though existing proxy-required or egress-controlled deployments may need a new durable opt-in env var after upgrade?
rationale: The diff intentionally changes a network egress default and adds a new env surface; tests can prove mechanics, but only maintainers can accept the compatibility and security-boundary policy tradeoff.

options.title: Finish direct-default contract
options.body: Land direct-by-default only after adding docs, current-head real transport proof, test cleanup, and an explicit maintainer approval of the egress-default change.

options.title: Preserve proxy-dependent upgrades
options.body: Keep ambient proxy inheritance as the default and add an explicit Feishu direct/bypass mode for mixed-proxy users.

options.title: Pause for broader proxy policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the Feishu HTTP and channel-level mixed-proxy direction is decided with the adjacent work.
